name: Mohit Pandey
bio: Almora-based builder, creator and musician working across civic technology, travel products, AI-assisted local services and music. Mohit is building Almora.ai as a practical coordination layer for everyday hill-town life and RoamWise as a travel-planning product, while publishing creator and music work through the @mohucool identity.
